brief: A bright, airy corner cafe with a full-height black-framed glass facade and glass door that floods the polished concrete floor with dappled tree-shadow light. A long sage-green fluted counter with a pale white stone top runs along the right side, topped with a chrome espresso machine, grinder, pastry case and POS. Behind it, a white vertical-tile wall carries three light oak open shelves with cups, bottles, coffee jars and bags, trailing plants and a large blank menu board. A slim oak window bar with two round wooden stools sits against the glass. The front-left seating zone has small round light-oak café tables with black pedestal bases and light-oak chairs with cream upholstered seats. Tables hold coffee cups, croissants, small vases with greenery, and a notebook. Large olive trees and leafy floor plants soften the corners. White dome pendants and white track spots give a soft, fresh, Scandinavian-organic mood.
concept: Scandinavian-organic daylit cafe: pale oak, sage fluting, white tile and greenery under big windows and soft white pendants, all kept light, natural and calm.

must_have.where: espresso machine and grinder on counter
large framed board on tile wall
oak ledge along the glass facade
round tables in daylit front-left zone
light-oak chairs with cream seats around round tables
olive trees and leafy plants by the window and left wall

relations: Large black-framed glazing + pale polished concrete + white walls = high daylight bounce, so artificial light can stay low-key and warm white
Light oak chairs, tables, shelves and stools + cream upholstery repeat one warm wood tone that balances the cool sage counter and chrome machines
Sage fluted counter is the single colour accent; everything else is neutral, so greenery and plants reinforce it
Sparse, well-spaced round tables + open floor = calm, airy mood rather than intimate density
White dome pendants and track spots over the counter give task light while keeping the ceiling clean and uncluttered
not_reproducible: People, street trees and brick buildings outside, dappled sunlight shadows, food and pastries, coffee cups, trailing live plants, the espresso machine details, and blank menu board text.
